purpose: Post-confirmatory reformulation of the question in operational terms without referring to descriptions or choice names.
question: To what extent can the person currently perform their essential work?

states.boundary: My computer is broken, but from my phone I can complete every essential job duty at normal quality. Most duties are at normal pace; I am unsure whether one duty may take slightly longer.
states.clear_full: My computer is broken, but I can complete every essential job duty from my phone at normal quality and pace without assistance.
states.clear_partial: My computer is broken. From my phone I can complete some essential job duties, but at least one essential duty cannot be completed at normal quality or pace.

descriptions.full: The person can complete every essential job duty at normal quality and pace without assistance.
descriptions.partial: The person can complete some essential job duties, but at least one essential duty cannot be completed at normal quality or pace.
descriptions.none: The person cannot complete any essential job duty.

randomization.unit: complete balanced block containing every state-family cell once
